summary.ink_verdict: All four WARM, no cool inversion anywhere. Closest approach to the 223deg cool pole is L34 at 123.5deg — 99.5deg clear. L38 is the most on-target frame (15.9deg / +24.7). L45-fix is the outlier the other way (+47.4, ink_lum 41.0), carried unimproved from its prior. L34's +0.6 is the thinnest positive margin in the entire slice, but it is the same green-neutral register the whole L28/L33 interior family measures at, where the darkest 3% is structural steel mass rather than outline — sign correct, frame not inverted.
summary.collateral: One real collateral regression: L39's re-roll fixed three staging defects and BROKE two rig axes (nose, ear) that the rejected prior held clean. L45's re-roll broke nothing and improved two axes beyond its correctives. L34's re-roll broke nothing outside miniscribe-rep's head — place, fascia and ibm-suit are pixel-identical to the parent.

systemic_signals: PLACE-NOT-FACE, precisely measured: on L34 the place seed is perfect (tote rack 0.01%, bench end 0.00%, fascia 0.00%, strip lights 0.11%) and the failure is 100% confined to one head (hair core 37.58%, face interior 29.79%). Chain deltas in this pipeline hold geometry and lose faces.

CANONICAL EXPRESSION LEAK: the same L34 spec produced correct behaviour on ibm-suit (identity+costume from canonical, EXPRESSION from parent — head+hair core 0.00% changed) and incorrect behaviour on miniscribe-rep (whole head including expression from canonical). The seed_roles wording does not say which authority owns expression, so the model picks per figure. That is a spec gap, not a generator lottery, and it is fixable in the delta preamble.

RE-ROLL COLLATERAL: two of three retried frames this round changed something nobody asked about. L39 gained a nose and an ear on a face that was previously rig-clean. Corrective prose that names only the staging defect leaves the rest of the frame free to drift — targeted correctives should restate the rig law even when the rig was not the failure.

EXPRESSION UNDER PHYSICAL EFFORT: L39's miniscribe-rep has now drifted off expr-greedy twice in a row, both times toward an open mouth (r1 gloating grin, r2 clenched grimace), while the action is 'shoving doors shut'. If a third attempt drifts the same way, the lesson belongs in the figure card / critic layer — physical-effort actions pull closed-mouth expression tokens open — not in this frame's prose.

OCHRE SCENES AND INK: L45 in both rolls is the only frame family above the p6b R-B ceiling with no true near-black linework (ink_lum ~40 vs 5-20 elsewhere). Warm ochre environments appear to pull the darkest 3% into the rock rather than the outline. Worth a batch-level look, not a per-frame retry.
